text:
jess_support: FYI escalated from CS-1428 — FinServCo reports objects that had a 30d TTL still show up via search and API after ~60 days. They want an export of what wasn't deleted + timeline. No delete events in audit logs we pulled. Can SRE/security triage?

matt_support: adding context — customer changed default retention to 30 days on 2025-11-02 and applied a custom bucket policy for a subset. We validated UI shows 30d but customer supplied object IDs that are still retrievable.

kai_eng-sre: thanks. Can you paste one or two object IDs and a sample GET/HEAD response? want metadata fields (x-ttl, retention policy id, last-modified). Also check deletion-queue backlog.

jess_support: example id: obj-finserv-2025-11-03-7a4f2c. They ran: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" 
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/objects/obj-finserv-2025-11-03-7a4f2c" -i
```
Response headers (redacted):```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/octet-stream
x-retention-ttl: 2592000
x-retention-policy-id: rp_30d_cust_9
last-modified: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 12:34:22 GMT
x-deleted: false
```
No delete events for that object in audit logs (searched by object id).

kai_eng-sre: ok. Couple of quick checks: 1) was there a KMS key rotation or HSM hold around TTL expiry? if encryption key is inaccessible deletes can be stalled. 2) is the deletion worker throwing 4xx/5xx for these objects? 3) are these objects in the deletion queue or already popped?

anita_security: I pulled key activity for the customer-managed key CMK-finserv-1: key rotation event on 2025-12-01 and a temporary HSM lock flag set by oncall for a misconfigured policy from 2025-12-02 03:12 UTC to 2025-12-02 05:09 UTC. The lock was cleared. I can share logs if needed.

ryan_platform: devops-bot shows several deletion-worker errors for that namespace around 2025-12-02: ```
[worker-12] ERROR delete_handler: unable to decrypt object obj-finserv-*-* : DecryptionFailed: HSM_LOCKED
[worker-12] INFO   requeueing object obj-finserv-*-* for retry
```
Looks like workers retried but backlog spiked.

matt_support: customer reports they see 5,200 objects still searchable that should've been removed. They want an export and assurance that data will be deleted. Also asking if legal hold could have applied accidentally.

anita_security: I checked legal-hold flags for that account — none set. There are audit entries where ops toggled a temporary hold on a test key, but not account-wide. Will attach audit snippets.

kai_eng-sre: likely root cause: HSM lock during deletion window caused deletion-worker to requeue; backlog retention window passed and worker eventually processed many but some requeues failed due to a bug in retry logic where TTL check wasn't re-evaluated after a successful decrypt. Action plan: 1) do a targeted job to enumerate objects with rp_30d_cust_9 and x-deleted:false and attempt server-side deletion with forced-decrypt path. 2) run audit export for all delete attempts between 2025-11-30 and 2025-12-10. 3) provide customer a CSV export + deletion timeline and re-run searches once completed.

jess_support: can you estimate how long the targeted job will take and if there is any customer-visible downtime? Customer is pushing for same-day resolution.

kai_eng-sre: small batch job to validate and delete ~5k objects should be < 2 hours once we have a maintenance window. Nonblocking to normal reads; we will throttle to avoid high load. Need approval to use forced-decrypt path (bypasses normal client key caching) — requires security signoff.

anita_security: approved for this emergency operation under CS-1428. We'll log every action and produce HSM audit trail. Legal_ops, FYI.

legal_ops: noted. Please include timestamps and object list in export; we'll review for any regulatory hold concerns.

ryan_platform: I'll kick off a safe-job template: ```json
{
  "query": "metadata.x-retention-policy-id:rp_30d_cust_9 AND metadata.x-deleted:false",
  "action": "server_side_delete_force_decrypt",
  "throttle": "50/s"
}
```
I'll run on staging with one shard first and report results.

devops-bot: job-runner started job jr-2025-12-03-09-12 (staging shard 1) — 0 failures so far, 120 tested, 0 unexpected deletes.

kai_eng-sre: after staging looks good, we'll run prod shard with monitoring. Need oncall for HSM team during the window in case of repeat lock.

matt_support: I'll notify FinServCo with interim update: we have a targeted deletion plan and expect full completion within 6 hours after prod start; will provide final CSV and audit log.

jess_support: thanks. tagging @anita_security @kai_eng-sre @ryan_platform to keep channel open for the export artifacts. I'll add the thread link to CS-1428.

anita_security: attaching HSM audit extract (in support ticket). After job completes we'll verify delete events are present and provide signed audit bundle.

kai_eng-sre: follow-ups: file a small bug report for retry logic (ticket INF-2241), add a guard to not requeue beyond grace window, and add alert on HSM_LOCKED spikes.

jess_support: resolved steps inline; moving to incident tracking and will close conversaton when CSV + audit bundle uploaded to the ticket.

matt_support: customer acknowledged interim plan and asked for postmortem. Marking for postmortem with eng/runtime and security once closed. :thumbsup:
